description: Build a new Google Ads Search campaign end-to-end: evidence intake, account structure, bidding and budget, keyword and match-type plan, RSA and assets, and measurement and launch — produced as a preview-approve-push bundle.

required.name: customer_id
required.description: Google Ads customer ID (under the MCC) the new Search campaign will be built in

required.name: target_geo_and_audience
required.description: Geographic targeting and audience definition for the campaign

required.name: campaign_objective
required.description: Primary objective and the conversion action(s) optimization should target

required.name: landing_page_urls
required.description: Landing page URL(s) the campaign will drive traffic to

optional.name: existing_account
optional.description: Existing account/campaign context for structure and negative-keyword reuse

optional.name: competitor_urls
optional.description: Competitor URLs for keyword and ad-copy competitive analysis

optional.name: historical_performance
optional.description: Prior search-term/keyword performance for benchmarking and bid seeding

optional.name: industry
optional.description: Industry vertical for benchmark CPCs and match-type strategy

tier_meaning.discovery: First 3 runs; requires operator present + Codex preview review + post-push readback match; no autonomous execution allowed
tier_meaning.stable: Operator-ratified after 3 successful discovery runs; allows Claude-executed preview→approve→push→readback cycles without operator present on every run, but every push still requires explicit per-change operator approval artifact
tier_meaning.hardened: Reserved for future graduation; criteria not yet defined

promotion_criteria.no_remediation_required_runs: all 3 must complete without rollback/fix-forward — any remediation-requiring run does not count toward promotion

attribution_note: Prompt-chain principles are distilled in our own words from Ed Leake's God Tier Ads library (${HOME}/Documents/1. some marketing/Resources/God Tier Ads/). Option b: principles + citations, no verbatim.
